items.title: Linux 7.3 Released
items.summary: The latest version of the Linux kernel, 7.3, has been released, introducing numerous performance improvements and new features. Developers should explore these updates to enhance their systems and applications leveraging Linux.

items.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
items.summary: A new paper presents Hybrid Reasoning Agents that utilize latent space for reasoning while interacting through text, enhancing the capabilities of LLMs. This development could significantly improve AI's decision-making processes in complex scenarios.

items.title: Tmux and Claude Code: Sessions, Send-Keys, and the Ceiling
items.summary: A new guide explores the integration of Tmux with Claude Code, focusing on session management and automation through send-keys. This resource is essential for developers looking to enhance their productivity in terminal-based environments.

items.title: If you don't run your own LLM proxy, how do you know what's going on?
items.summary: This article discusses the importance of running your own LLM proxy to gain insights into the workings of AI models. Developers and engineers should consider this approach to better understand and control their AI implementations.

items.title: Free Pascal compiler now supports dynamic packages
items.summary: The Free Pascal compiler has introduced support for dynamic packages, enhancing its capabilities for developers. This update allows for more modular and flexible application development, which is crucial for modern software engineering.
